title: Explorer 1 launched on Imbolc

tellings.quote: Over 20 years later, Explorer 1, the first US satellite built by JPL, was launched on January 31st, 1958.

plain: Explorer 1, the first American satellite, was launched on January 31, 1958, a date Michels ties to Imbolc, an old Celtic festival held at the start of February. Michels tells this himself in an episode about pagan ritual in the space program. He notes that the satellite was built by JPL, a rocket laboratory in California, and suggests the timing was chosen to match the old calendar.
